prompt: Clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection of a tiered modular server stack on a control room desk. Arranged with extreme asymmetry, a small bone white polymer top node separates from a massive, dense graphite and cobalt support array below. Constructed of brushed steel, copper busbars, and matte polymer. Illuminated by a single directional key light from the left casting sharp long shadows across the desk surface, flat muted palette, thin consistent line weight, generous empty margin, no text.

rationale: A technical isometric cutaway perfectly illustrates the systemic architecture of an AI stack, physically separating the visible 'key' from the massive, hidden 'harness' below it to represent the off-invoice spend.

core_thesis: A provider invoice captures only the API key's token usage, leaving the 40 to 60 percent of costs generated by the underlying AI harness hidden and decoupled from the business unit.
core_conflict: The demand for per-business-unit cost visibility versus the fragmented, multi-vendor reality of AI infrastructure billing.
